description: TinyCC port (M6 capstone) first behavioral proof: userspace/ctests/tcc_hello.c is compiled on the host by the Dunit cross-tcc (toolchains/dunit-tcc, built via tools/dunit/build-tcc.sh against build/dunit-sysroot) into a native x86_64-dunit static ELF, packed as /app/tcc_hello, and run on the kernel. sum(1..100)=5050 in the output proves tcc codegen (loop+arithmetic) and that the tcc-emitted ELF links our crt/libc and runs. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_tcc_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 260 --boot-timeout 150

required.marker: [TCC-HELLO] ok: built by tcc, ran on Dunit
required.claim: a tcc-compiled Dunit ELF ran on the kernel
